text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the "Community Exchange Cops and Robbers Tournament."
A friendly event bringing together Tracen Academy students and elementary school horse girls dreaming of enrollment.

text_block_list.name: Tournament Head
text_block_list.text:
The Cops team wins if they catch
all members of the Robbers team within the time limit!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Head
text_block_list.text:
The Robbers team wins if even one person
manages to evade capture until time runs out!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's on the Robbers team, so I just gotta keep running until time is up, right? Piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Head
text_block_list.text:
Trainers and local shopping district staff,
please stay with your assigned teams to ensure everyone's safety!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If you're standing over here...
Are you on the Robbers team too!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the small stuff! You're an ally too!
Turbo's gonna leave everyone in the dust, so relax!

text_block_list.name: Elementary Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: There are so many big sisters from Tracen Academy...! All right, Cops team! Let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best
so we don't lose because of Rice...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Allow me the privilege of assisting the Cops team
so that we may secure our victory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
From effective team tactics
to stamina management, please leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, that team over there
is exploding with motivation too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, challenge accepted!
Robbers team, let's goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Head
text_block_list.text:
All participants,
on your marks—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*BANG!*)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, full throttle ahead!
Run for it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first, both teams engaged in a chaotic scramble,
but as time went on, the Cops team's movements began to settle down.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The cops aren't chasing as much as earlier!
Why? Turbo's waiting for them!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Running around blindly will only deplete our stamina.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let us remain calm and observe the opponent's moves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained to Twin Turbo that this was likely Ikuno Dictus's strategy
to minimize stamina loss while capturing robbers efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!! What's with that!!
That's so boooring!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wants to run!
I wanna play tag with everyone!!
choice_data_list: If you rush out, you'll play right into their hands.
If you jump out, you're doing exactly what they want.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: It's fine, 'cause Turbo is super fast!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fuf-fuun!
Turbo is strong! It'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps Twin Turbo intends to draw the opposing team's attention all on her own.
choice_data_list: You have to hold back here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps Twin Turbo intends to draw the opposing team's attention all on her own.
choice_data_list: You have to hold back here.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
Turbo's moving oooout!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Found you!
Rice spotted!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eh, Turbo-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wait uuuup! You're not getting away from me, police!
Face Turbo in a faaaair fight!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fueee!?
Wait, please wait! Don't charge at meee!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-Why are you chasing after me...!?

text_block_list.name: Elementary Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Elementary Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Is it a special rule...? 
Should we be running away too?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, please stay as you are.
Everyone, remain on standby.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...We need to stop her quickly,
though doing so looks like it will take considerable effort.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yahoーー! Wait wait waaaait!!
Ahaha! Now this is what a game of tag is all about!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Twin Turbo mysteriously chasing down the Police Team
and plunging everything into total chaos, the Cops and Robbers
game was temporarily put on hold...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHAHA! You won't get away, police!
Face Turbo in a faaaair fi—...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Bubehh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa!
T-Turbo-san!?

text_block_list.name: Patrolling Man
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, are you alright, kiddo!?
You just faceplanted straight into the ground...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fi... ght... Run with... Turbo...
Ehehe......

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *collapses*

text_block_list.name: Patrolling Trainer
text_block_list.text: Wait, she passed out while still smiling...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Gasp!
What happened to the match!?
choice_data_list: It ended, and the Police Team won.
It ended, and the Police Team won!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Byaaa!? I-I-It's al-already overrr!?
Even though Turbo didn't get to run!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hnngh, uuu~... That's so frustraaaating!
Next time, Turbo is gonna win no matter whaaaat!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wailing at the top of her lungs,
Twin Turbo made a solemn vow to the setting sun...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh!? Why, why?!
No no no nooo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run! 
Turbo haaaates not running!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Police Team, now is our chance!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Ikuno!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Surround complete. Thanks to your loud shouting,
I was able to guide everyone here without you noticing.

text_block_list.name: Elementary Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: You can't get away anymore, Twin Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAYYYY!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You're all gonna play tag with Turbo?
Alright! Let's do this, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four... Six people! Six against one!
Can you guys keep up with Turbo!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Here goes!
TURBO FULL THROTTLEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Everyone, please wait!
If you try to match Turbo-san's pace—

text_block_list.name: Elementary Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: I-Impossibleee...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...You will drop out from exhaustion.
I should have warned them sooner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, both Twin Turbo and the Police Team
ran completely out of stamina, bringing the
game to an end in a draw...
